template.name: Miami Bass / Electro
template.about: TR-808 drum rack, long sub boom, vocoder, 128 BPM electro chassis.

project.name: Miami Bass / Electro
project.notes:
MIAMI BASS / ELECTRO  (Planet Rock 1982; Egyptian Lover, 2 Live Crew, Dynamix II)

SOUND
TR-808 drums with the kick tuned and held long as the bass line, electro stabs and arps,
robotic voices. Tempo of the records varies; 125-135 is a working range (unconfirmed).

REFERENCE GEAR (sourced)
- Arthur Baker on Planet Rock: "we heard the 808 and we said, 'That's it!'"; also Micromoog,
  Prophet-5 and Fairlight (RBMA Daily). The 808 was rented for $25 a night; the orchestra hit
  came from a Fairlight (Music Technology, 1989).
- "There would be no Miami bass without the 808"; Baker credits Dynamix II with tuning the 808
  kick into a bass line (Miami New Times).

WORKFLOW
Program the 808 Drums pattern (swing 52%). The drum rack plays one-shots synthesized for these templates (CC0, no recordings), in the voice of the machine each channel is named for, with a starter beat in the pattern; replace them with your own samples for the real machine. The 808 Boom track is Surge XT "Sub 2" in
mono with a short glide; play it as the bass line and as long kick tails.

MIX NOTES
- The boom is the loudest thing: sub at -3 dB, kick short. Watch the true peak; subs eat
  headroom.
- Drum Bus: slow built-in compression, then Lemon Soft Clipper.
- No reverb on the sub; short room on claps only.
- Loudness: streaming plays back near -14 LUFS integrated (Spotify), so a louder master is turned down; keep true peak below -1 dBTP. Working target -9 to -7 LUFS (club records were cut loud).

COVERAGE
Medium. The 808 voices are synthesized one-shots; the long boom is a synth sub (Surge XT), which also
works without a long-decay kick sample.

SOURCES
RBMA Daily "Key Tracks: Arthur Baker on Planet Rock" (2013); Music Technology 1989 "Disciple
of the Beat"; Miami New Times Arthur Baker interview; Spotify for Artists, "Loudness normalization" (support.spotify.com/us/artists/article/loudness-normalization).

FREE PLUG-INS (download them before opening the template; a missing one keeps its slot)
- Surge XT (GPL-3.0): https://surge-synthesizer.github.io/
- OB-Xf (GPL-3.0): https://github.com/surge-synthesizer/OB-Xf
- TAL-Vocoder (freeware): https://tal-software.com/products/tal-vocoder

SETUP (written from this template)
Tempo 128 BPM, 4/4, key Emin, cycle bars 1-4.

Tracks
- 808 Drums (Instrument, +0 dB) -> Drum Bus
    instrument: Channel Rack (synthesized one-shots of the template samples: Kick (808) = kick-808.wav, Snare (808) = snare-808.wav, Closed Hat (808) = hat-808.wav, Open Hat (808) = openhat-808.wav, Clap (909) = clap.wav, Rim (909) = rim.wav)
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -12, Ratio 4, Attack 30, Release 80, Make-up 2)
    region: Step Sequencer pattern with a starter beat (16 steps on), swing 52% (MPC terms), 6 rows = the rack's channels
- 808 Boom (Instrument, -3 dB) -> Drum Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: Surge XT: Surge XT patch "Basses/Sub 2"; A Play Mode 0.5, A Portamento 0.3
    strip FX: Overdrive (Drive 7, Tone 9000, Level -4, Mix 0.6)
- Electro Stab (Instrument, -10 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: Surge XT: Surge XT patch "Chords/Tek Stab"
    send: Delay (bus 5) at -14 dB
- Robot Voice (Instrument, -10 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: OB-Xf: OB-Xf patch "Leads/Mono Monsta"
    FX: TAL-Togu Audio Line: TAL-Vocoder-2: default settings
- Arp Synth (Instrument, -14 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: Surge XT: Surge XT patch "Sequences/S&H Classic"
    send: Delay (bus 5) at -16 dB
- MC / Hype (Audio, +0 dB) -> Vocal Bus
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -20, Ratio 4, Attack 0.5, Release 60, Make-up 3)
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -22, Release 300, Make-up 3)
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -20 dB
    send: Delay (bus 5) at -18 dB

Buses (the n-th Aux strip listens to bus n)
- Drum Bus (bus 1): Lemon Soft Clipper: default settings; Compressor (Threshold -16, Ratio 2, Attack 20, Release 300, Make-up 2)
- Music Bus (bus 2): Channel EQ (High 1.5)
- Vocal Bus (bus 3): empty
- Reverb (bus 4): Space D (Dry -96, Wet 0, Decay 0.6, Decay Curve 1, IR "00.5s Small Room")
- Delay (bus 5): Tape Delay (Time 351.6, Tone 5000, Ping-Pong 1, Mix 1)

Stereo Out
- built-in effects: Channel EQ (Low 2); Compressor (Threshold -10, Ratio 2.5, Attack 30, Release 200)
- plug-ins (after the built-in effects): Lemon Soft Clipper: default settings; Lemon Limiter: gain +4 dB, ceiling -1 dB, other settings default

Bring your own samples: no recordings are included.
